fdroid:app.kotowski.keepsimalive.vanilla.name: Keep SIM Alive
fdroid:app.kotowski.keepsimalive.vanilla.summary: Scheduled keep-alive SMS so prepaid, roaming or backup SIMs stay active
fdroid:app.kotowski.keepsimalive.vanilla.description:
Keep SIM Alive sends an SMS on the schedule you define so your prepaid, roaming, or backup SIM card is never deactivated for inactivity.
 How it works 
For each SIM on the device you set a recipient, a message, and a schedule for when the message goes out. Each keep-alive is a regular SMS: your carrier may charge for it as per your plan.
 Features 
 Dual-SIM device support
 Fixed send time or a random window
 Off-schedule manual send
 Send history with per-message outcomes
 Automatic retries if network is down or the SIM is removed
 Live SIM status to clearly identify the SIM
 Schedule per SIM card and not per slot, so the schedule follows the SIM
 Optional sticky notification while keep-alive is on
 Survives reboots and app updates
 Privacy 
The app has no internet permission and makes no network calls: keep-alive messages are sent directly over the cellular network and all data stays on your device. No advertising, no tracking, no analytics.
 Permissions 
 Send SMS — the keep-alive message itself
 Read phone state — to properly link the schedule to a certain SIM card
 Show notifications — recommended for sticky notification
 Boot completed — to re-arm the schedule after a reboot
 Ignore battery optimizations — optional but recommended, for reliable wake-ups
 Schedule exact alarms (Android 12+) — optional and experimental, for wake-ups despite aggressive battery optimizations; recommended on devices known to kill background apps. On Android 12-14 you grant it via a separate Alarms & reminders toggle, and on Android 15+ the battery exemption above grants it automatically

fdroid:com.siddarthkay.nullpointer.description:
null-pointer is a native client for devnull (https://dev-null.sh), the social
network for developers that reads like a git log. Posts are commits, replies
are branches, and the whole thing fits in your pocket.
* Read the log, open a commit and follow its replies as a graph
* Post commits and reply from your phone
* Notifications for replies, stars and new followers
* Profiles, with your own stats and settings
* Light and dark themes
There are no passwords or tokens. On first launch the app generates an
ed25519 key in the Android Keystore and signs every request with it. Sign in
with GitHub happens on dev-null.sh in the system browser; the app never sees
your GitHub password.
The app talks only to devnull (or an instance you point it at). It sends no
analytics, crash reports or advertising identifiers, and contains no tracking
SDKs.
A devnull account is needed, and devnull signs you in through GitHub.

fdroid:com.weenas.castbay.summary: AirPlay and DLNA receiver for Android TVs, TV boxes, car displays and tablets
fdroid:com.weenas.castbay.description:
CastBay turns an Android big screen — a TV, a TV box, a car display or a tablet — into an AirPlay and DLNA receiver. Cast your iPhone, iPad or Mac screen, music and videos to it, or use the cast button in video and music apps.
 Features 
 Screen mirroring from iPhone, iPad and Mac, up to 60 fps; H.265 up to 4K on TVs with a hardware HEVC decoder.
 Music with the cover as a blurred backdrop and optional synced lyrics; AirPlay music is lossless and stays in time with the phone.
 Video casting : apps' AirPlay video plays straight from the source, with audio tracks and subtitles.
 DLNA : the cast button in apps such as Bilibili, iQiyi, NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music, from iPhones and Android phones.
 Remote or touch screen : a quick menu while playing (picture fit, playback stats, audio and subtitles, pause, skip and a seek bar); media keys and a car's steering-wheel buttons pause and change tracks.
 Who can cast : anyone, devices you allow on the TV, a PIN shown on the TV (as on an Apple TV) or a password; block any device.
 Works on Android 6.0 and later, in English and Chinese.
 Privacy : no account and no ads. Nothing is sent unless you choose to: lyrics lookups, problem reports (with personal details taken out) and anonymous usage statistics are all off until you turn them on.
 The phone and the screen need to be on the same local network. Music from the Mac's Music app isn't supported (a FairPlay mode UxPlay can't handle).
 CastBay is free software (GPL-3.0), built on UxPlay, libplist, Apple's ALAC, OpenSSL and Media3. User guide and FAQ: https://castbay.weenas.com

fdroid:io.gitlab.jrock902.cypherleaf.name: CypherLeaf
fdroid:io.gitlab.jrock902.cypherleaf.summary: Private, offline notes with folders, tags, and a lock for sensitive entries.
fdroid:io.gitlab.jrock902.cypherleaf.description:
CypherLeaf is a clean, private note-taking app for Android. It works fully
offline, has no ads, no trackers, and no account. Your notes stay on your
device.
Features:
* Notes with folders and tags to keep things organised
* Pin important notes to the top
* Trash with restore, so a delete is never final by accident
* App lock using your device biometric or screen lock
* Protected notes: individual notes and their attachments are encrypted with
 AES-GCM, and the key is held in the Android Keystore, separate from the
 notes database
* Attachments on notes
* Reminders with notifications
* A home-screen widget for recent and pinned notes
* Export notes as plain text, Markdown, or JSON
* Encrypted portable backup protected by a passphrase (PBKDF2 + AES-GCM),
 so you can move your notes to a new device safely
* Light and dark themes, with an adjustable font size
Privacy:
CypherLeaf requests no internet permission in its release build, so it
cannot send your notes anywhere. Fonts are bundled with the app rather
than downloaded. Protected notes and encrypted backups never leave the
device in readable form.
Only notes you mark as protected are encrypted. Other notes are kept in the
app's private storage, which other apps cannot read, but they are not
encrypted by CypherLeaf. Android's own cloud backup and phone-to-phone
transfer are switched off, so nothing is copied off the device unless you
export it; use the encrypted backup to move to a new phone.

 are running

 Multi-backend management with customizable per-operation profiles
 Troubleshooting: If you encounter an "Invalid binary" error during setup, it is likely caused
 by an outdated system rclone binary. Go to Settings → Core, clear the rclone binary path, and click
 Save & Reset Engine. When prompted, let the app download and install the latest rclone version
 automatically.
 For other issues such as a blank screen or freezes on Linux, refer to the Linux Troubleshooting
 Guide linked below.

flathub:me.amankhanna.opendeck.name: OpenDeck
flathub:me.amankhanna.opendeck.description:
OpenDeck is an application for using stream controller devices like the Elgato Stream Deck.
 OpenDeck supports the majority of the original Stream Deck plugins, like Elgato's own Discord plugin, unlike other softwares (e.g. streamdeck-ui, StreamController, Boatswain) which are much more limited.
 Please note that you will need to install udev subsystem rules for your device to be detected. For more information, see the Installation section of the project README on GitHub.
 Some compiled plugins are not compiled for Linux, so you may need to have Wine (and Wine Mono) installed on your system (natively, as the Wine Flatpak is not supported). Similarly, for using plugins made with Node.js, the Node.js Flatpak is not supported.
 From Multi Actions and Toggle Actions to switching profiles when you switch apps and brightness control, OpenDeck has all the features you'd expect from stream controller software.
 Consider that the power of your Stream Deck actually comes from the software you use with it, then remember how much you paid for it. To support OpenDeck's development, please consider donating to me on GitHub Sponsors, Ko-fi or Liberapay.

For a one-time purchase of just $0.99 - with NO subscription fees, NO ads, and NO data tracking - you can upcycle your hardware into a gorgeous, high-visibility dedicated wall display that rivals expensive smart-home screens.
--------------------------------------------------
KEY FEATURES
--------------------------------------------------
* GLOBAL CLOCK & CALENDAR
- Universal Timekeeper: Type in any city worldwide, and the clock immediately shifts to display that location’s exact local date and time.
- Highly Customizable: Choose between standard 12-hour (with AM/PM) or 24-hour clock displays, and easily toggle the seconds indicator on or off.
- Aesthetic Typography: Select from a curated list of wall-clock optimized fonts, including clean system styles, geometric industrial designs, or our signature retro "Flip Clock" bold typeface.
* REAL-TIME WEATHER STATION
- At-a-Glance Metrics: Displays current temperature, precise weather conditions, and high-detail dynamic weather symbols that automatically shift to reflect day or night states in the target timezone.
- Comprehensive Environmental Data: Track real-time metrics including wind speed/direction, current humidity, daily forecast average humidity, UV index, and official US EPA Air Quality Index (AQI) ratings.
- Extreme Temperature Indicators: The temperature readout dynamically highlights in bright red when conditions exceed 90 degrees F, or bright green between 70 and 80 degrees F, giving you instant environmental awareness from a distance.
* SEVERE WEATHER ALERTS
- NWS Integration: For US locations, the app directly hooks into the official United States National Weather Service API to display real-time emergency warning banners (Tornado, Flood, Blizzard warnings).
- Detailed Descriptions: Tap the warning banner to open a clean, monospaced details page to read the complete government-issued severity text and instructions.
- Global Fallback: For international regions, the app automatically evaluates local parameters and raises native warnings for extreme heat or high-wind events.
* ASTRONOMICAL TRACKING
- Displays the current phase of the moon with high-resolution, beautifully rendered astronomical glyphs and matching descriptive text (e.g., Waning Crescent, Waxing Gibbous).
* MODERN, TAILORED AESTHETICS
- Customize your display to fit any room. Select a pure, high-contrast solid black background, one of our vibrant built-in macOS-style gradient themes (Big Sur, Sonoma, Aurora, Sunset), or upload a personal family photo that automatically crops and scales to fit your screen perfectly.
- Tap your custom logo on the top-left to slide open a built-in web browser overlay navigating directly to your website.
--------------------------------------------------
WHY CHOOSE WALL CLOCK WEATHER?
--------------------------------------------------
* Zero Subscriptions: Buy once, own forever.
* Zero Advertisements: No visual clutter, no interruptions.
* Responsive Vector UI: Every font, capsule, and layout coordinate scales mathematically, keeping the screen pixel-perfect whether run on a Macbook, iPad, or Android tablet.
* Upcycling Value: Turn older, unsupported, or lying-around devices into an invaluable permanent fixture in your home, kitchen, or office.
Transform your space today with Wall Clock Weather.
